description: Returns the total number of servers in the Official MCP Registry, new servers in the last 7 and 30 days, the 3 latest MCP and A2A spec changes with source links, and the snapshot date. Example output: {"total_servers":49749,"new_servers_last_7_days":{"count":3806},"snapshot_date":"2026-10-25"}. No arguments. Good for 'How big is the MCP ecosystem and what changed lately?'.
name: ecosystem_overview
